name: SketricGen Chat Widget
author: Sketric

sections.description:
SketricGen Chat Widget makes it easy to integrate a smart, real-time AI agent into your WordPress site with just a few clicks. This widget connects your website visitors to your configured SketricGen agent for seamless interaction and support.
Install our WordPress plugin on your website by following our step-by-step guideline.

Highlights:
– One-click setup with Agent ID
– Real-time conversations
– Fully customizable agent behavior and appearance
– No data is stored in your WordPress installation

Privacy and Terms

This plugin connects to SketricGen’s servers to provide real-time AI chat functionality. While no data is stored in your WordPress site, your visitors’ chat messages may be processed by SketricGen in accordance with its policies.

  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms & Conditions
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory and activate it
  2. Go to Settings > SketricGen Chat
  3. Enter your Agent ID (from your SketricGen account), enable the chat widget and click Save
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Agent ID?

Log in to https://sketricgen.ai, then copy your Agent ID from the agent dashboard.

Does this plugin collect or store user data?

No data is collected or stored in WordPress. All chats are handled securely via SketricGen’s servers.

Can I customize the look and behavior of the chat agent?

Yes. You can fully configure your agent’s appearance, language, and actions within the SketricGen platform.

Is the chat widget GDPR-compliant?

The plugin itself does not track users or store data. If your website requires user consent, please ensure that a consent banner or message is added before the widget appears.
